entities.context: Bernard Andreae graduated from Marburg in 1956 under Friedrich Matz, specializing in Roman sarcophagi; his thesis analyzed historical motifs within sarcophagus iconography.
From 1956 to 1959, he served as Assistant at the German Archaeological Institute in Italy.

This work absorbed him during his tenure as professor at Bochum (1965-1977) and Marburg (from 1978), until his appointment as Director of the German Archaeological Institute in Rome in 1984 (until 1995).
